title: feat: API rate limiter with X-Forwarded-For composite key
author: arjun.mehta
description:
Implements IP-based rate limiting middleware for all API endpoints. After security review by Kenji Nakamura (email_09), updated to:
- Use X-Forwarded-For header + user ID composite key to correctly handle load balancers and NAT (NEX-233)
- Add Retry-After header to all 429 responses (RFC 7231 compliance)
- Log throttled requests to security audit trail

The /webhooks/stripe endpoint is explicitly excluded — see PR #56 for that endpoint's HMAC-based auth approach (approved in email_12).

Related: NEX-231, NEX-233, email_04, email_09, email_12, docs/api-rate-limiting.md

review_comments.author: kenji.nakamura
review_comments.comment: X-Forwarded-For fix LGTM. Retry-After header correctly implemented. Approve with the audit logging added.
